title: Organ-specific learned networks prioritize tested seed-lipid regulators
summary: Learned organ classification enabled regulatory-network inference that nominated seed-lipid regulators for genetic and physiological testing in Arabidopsis. The result was public in a June 2023 preprint before the April 2024 journal article. Candidate counts differ between versions, so the entry does not transfer final-version counts or mechanistic detail to the preprint. Crop-yield benefit was not established.
ai_technology: K-nearest-neighbor organ classification and regulatory-network inference

evidence.tested: Predicted regulators received genetic and physiological experimental follow-up.
evidence.unknown: Cross-species utility, crop performance and version-specific numerical correspondence remain unestablished.
evidence.ai_role: K-nearest-neighbor organ classification and regulatory-network inference supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Primary bioRxiv API v1 abstract/date plus journal abstract, selected Methods and affiliations; no full preprint numerical endpoints transferred.
